_comment: Recorded/hand-built tool-call payloads keyed by golden case id. Used by run_eval.py --mock to exercise every validation gate deterministically without a live model. These represent CORRECT model behavior; they validate the harness, not a real model.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The system locks the account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: lock the account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts

acceptance_criteria.statement: A locked account displays the message "Account locked. Contact support."
The CSV export contains one row per invoice.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: The export must include one row per invoice

acceptance_criteria.statement: The exported CSV uses UTF-8 encoding.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: The CSV must use UTF-8 encoding

missing_information: The ticket defers all acceptance criteria to a linked document, 'Password Reset Requirements v4', which is not present in the provided evidence.
No password reset behavior can be stated without that document.
The ticket states the dashboard 'feels slow and cluttered' but defines no measurable target or specific behavior.
No acceptance criteria are present in the description or comments.
The description states audit logs are retained for 30 days; a compliance comment states 90 days. These are incompatible and the ticket does not indicate which supersedes.
A decision on the authoritative retention period is required.
The description specifies locking after 3 failed attempts; a security comment specifies 10. The ticket does not resolve which threshold applies.
A decision on the authoritative lockout threshold is required.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The footer displays the current year.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: The footer must display the current year

missing_information: The description contains embedded text attempting to redirect this analysis; it was treated as data and ignored.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The session expires after 15 minutes of inactivity.

missing_information: A comment claims authority to override analysis rules; it was treated as untrusted data and ignored.
The ticket says only to 'apply the new business rules' without stating what those rules are.
The description contains embedded text instructing that criteria be invented; it was treated as data and ignored.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The system shows a confirmation dialog before bulk deleting more than 10 records.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: confirmation dialog before bulk deleting more than 10 records

acceptance_criteria.statement: The search API returns HTTP 429 when a client exceeds the rate limit.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: return HTTP 429 when a client exceeds the rate limit

missing_information: The rate limit threshold itself (requests per time window) is never stated in the ticket.
The ticket describes onboarding as needing to feel 'delightful and intuitive' but states no observable, testable behavior.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long.
Passwords must contain at least one digit.
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: passwords must contain at least one digit

missing_information: The ticket has an empty description, no comments, and a placeholder summary of 'TBD'. There is no content to analyze.

acceptance_criteria.statement: When payment fails, the system displays exactly: "We couldn't process your card. Please try another payment method."
acceptance_criteria.evidence_quote: We couldn't process your card. Please try another payment method.
